packages.title: Amnezia6
packages.status_text: iOS 7 verified: package install, root daemon, UTUN/route setup and the arm64 SpringBoard badge hook. Tunnel handshake was not retested because the VPS is unreachable from the test LAN.

packages.title: Performance Overlay
packages.tagline: FPS / CPU / RAM / GPU HUD for iOS 4.3–9
packages.status_text: iOS 7: universal armv7 + arm64 dylib installed; SpringBoard respawned and stayed up with the hook loaded. Visual HUD output on iOS 7 was not captured.

packages.title: Power Logger
packages.tagline: Battery and per-process CPU logger for iOS 6–7
packages.status_text: iOS 7.1.2 arm64: installed, launchd started the universal daemon, status.json written. Recording stays off until enabled.

packages.title: Legacy Game FPS
packages.tagline: Per-game frame pacing for exact legacy builds
packages.status_text: Verified on iOS 6.1.3 against the exact game builds listed in the project. The armv7 package allows iOS 7, but no iOS 7 game session has been measured yet.

packages.title: Veteris Native iPad
packages.tagline: Native iPad layout and suspension fix for Veteris 4
packages.status_text: iOS 6 verified. 1.2.0 adds an iOS 7 shader-cache guard and allows iOS 7, but the app has not been run on iOS 7 yet.

packages.title: LocalSend 6
packages.tagline: LocalSend client for old iOS devices
packages.status_text: Verified on iOS 6.1.3. The package has no upper firmware cap, so it is visible on iOS 7, but iOS 7 launch and transfer tests are still pending.

packages.title: Blastron Revival
packages.tagline: Compatibility and engine fixes for Blastron
packages.status_text: Built and tested against Blastron on iOS 6 only; the package keeps firmware < 7.0. It contains no original game assets.
packages.source: binary-only; build inputs contain game-derived addresses

packages.title: Legacy Timezone Update
packages.status_text: The installer validates the iOS ICU layout and intentionally refuses iOS 7; a separate iOS 7 ICU adapter is still required.
packages.source: binary-only; build inputs contain Apple ICU data

packages.title: Legacy Device Access
packages.status_text: The helper refuses any OS other than 4.3.3 and 6.1.3 on purpose. It is a diagnostic tool, not an iOS 7 package.
